resources.string: Tap the button, open the menu in the file picker, choose Google Drive and a folder, then tap Save. Sikkanam replaces that file with a fresh backup every day, and the Drive app uploads it. Receipt photos are not included. The last 7 daily backups are also kept on this phone.
No automatic backup has finished yet.
The last backup could not be written. Check that the Drive app is signed in, or choose the file again.
Phone storage is low, so the Drive file was left as it was. Free some space and the backup will try again.
%1$d daily backups kept on this phone.
This replaces everything in the app with the copy you pick.
